title: TOPS-20 V7 paging, APR and boot source
summary: Guest-oracle source set for understanding PGRINI, page-fault dispatch, APR/NXM handling, POSTLD placement, BOOT memory discovery, and resident/swap monitor maps.
procedure: Use PAGUTL/PAGEM to identify which initialization phase owns the failing instruction.
Use APRSRV for page-fault codes, UPT frame use, parity/NXM dispatch and fatal/recovery behavior.
Use POSTLD to explain image relocation such as PNRCOD rather than assuming a runtime corruption.
Use BOOT to understand physical memory probing and how monitor pages are loaded before PGRINI.
invariants: A familiar monitor address is not enough; identify the source label and initialization phase.
Expected memory-scan NXM handling must be distinguished from earlier initialization touching required core.
UPT new-PC contents may be deliberately replaced during initialization; compare the active phase before judging a vector wrong.
